import React, { useState } from 'react'; const AlertHistory: React.FC = () => { const [severity, setSeverity] = useState(''); const [status, setStatus] = useState(''); const [expandedId, setExpandedId] = useState(null); // Alertes statiques cohérentes avec les attaques détectables par votre modèle const [alerts, setAlerts] = useState([ { id: 1, timestamp: new Date(Date.now() - 7200000).toISOString(), src_ip: '203.45.67.89', dst_ip: '192.168.1.1', protocol: 'TCP', port: 80, attack_type: 'DDoS Attack (SYN flood)', confidence: 0.98, severity: 'critical', explanation: 'High rate of SYN packets from multiple sources detected', status: 'new', notes: '' }, { id: 2, timestamp: new Date(Date.now() - 5400000).toISOString(), src_ip: '185.142.53.12', dst_ip: '192.168.1.1', protocol: 'TCP', port: 22, attack_type: 'SSH Brute Force', confidence: 0.95, severity: 'critical', explanation: 'Multiple failed login attempts from single IP', status: 'acknowledged', notes: 'IP blocked via firewall' }, { id: 3, timestamp: new Date(Date.now() - 3600000).toISOString(), src_ip: '45.142.182.99', dst_ip: '192.168.1.1', protocol: 'TCP', port: 443, attack_type: 'Port Scan (TCP SYN)', confidence: 0.87, severity: 'high', explanation: 'Systematic probing of multiple ports detected', status: 'new', notes: '' }, { id: 4, timestamp: new Date(Date.now() - 1800000).toISOString(), src_ip: '192.168.1.100', dst_ip: '10.0.0.5', protocol: 'UDP', port: 53, attack_type: 'UDP Flood (DoS)', confidence: 0.92, severity: 'high', explanation: 'Large volume of UDP packets to DNS port', status: 'new', notes: '' }, { id: 5, timestamp: new Date(Date.now() - 300000).toISOString(), src_ip: '198.51.100.7', dst_ip: '192.168.1.1', protocol: 'ICMP', port: 0, attack_type: 'ICMP Flood (Ping flood)', confidence: 0.79, severity: 'medium', explanation: 'High rate of ICMP echo requests', status: 'new', notes: '' } ]); // Filtrage local const filteredAlerts = alerts.filter(a => (severity === '' || a.severity === severity) && (status === '' || a.status === status) ); // Fonctions d'export (simulées, à connecter à l'API si besoin) const handleExportCSV = () => { console.log('Export CSV des alertes', { severity, status }); }; const handleExportPDF = () => { console.log('Export PDF des alertes', { severity, status }); }; // Action "Marquer comme reconnu" – modifie l'état local const handleAcknowledge = (id: number) => { setAlerts(prevAlerts => prevAlerts.map(alert => alert.id === id && alert.status === 'new' ? { ...alert, status: 'acknowledged' } : alert ) ); }; // Action "Ajouter une note" (simple console pour l'exemple) const handleAddNote = (id: number) => { const note = prompt('Ajouter une note :'); if (note) { setAlerts(prevAlerts => prevAlerts.map(alert => alert.id === id ? { ...alert, notes: note } : alert ) ); } }; return (

Historique des Alertes

{filteredAlerts.map(alert => (
setExpandedId(expandedId === alert.id ? null : alert.id)} >
{alert.severity.toUpperCase()}

{alert.attack_type}

{alert.src_ip} → {alert.dst_ip}
{expandedId === alert.id ? '▼' : '▶'}
{expandedId === alert.id && (

{new Date(alert.timestamp).toLocaleString()}

{alert.src_ip}

{alert.dst_ip}

{alert.protocol} / {alert.port}

{alert.attack_type}

{(alert.confidence * 100).toFixed(0)}%

{alert.explanation}

{alert.notes && (

{alert.notes}

)}
)}
))}
); }; export default AlertHistory;
